scope: freeze exact commit or dirty candidate and prepare one bounded non-live successor
failure_boundaries: only failed or blocked predecessor statuses are accepted
commit candidates must be clean descendants; dirty candidates freeze patch and deterministic snapshot
ownership violations fail before partial candidate artifacts are written
proofs must bind the same manifest
projection rechecks predecessor, candidate, and proof hashes
known_limits: No live successor task or recovery command was executed.
One-new-fact quality still requires human review.
Symlink, submodule, LFS, large-file, and complex rename policies are incomplete.
